self_contained_context.background: CombatRound orchestrates single combat round with ATTACKER ADVANTAGE: (1) Attacker attacks first, (2) Defender counter-attacks ONLY if HP > 0 after attacker's strike, (3) If attacker kills defender, round ends (no counter-attack).

business_rules.attacker_advantage: Attacker strikes first. Defender counter-attacks ONLY if alive after attacker's strike.
business_rules.no_counter_if_dead: If defender HP = 0 after attacker's attack, defender_damage = 0 (no counter-attack)
business_rules.role_persistence: Attacker/defender roles persist from initiative through entire combat. Same character attacks first EVERY round.
business_rules.combat_ended: Round ends if either character reaches HP = 0

task_specification.name: Implement RoundResult and CombatRound
task_specification.motivation: Implements critical business rule (DR-06): attacker advantage. Demonstrates domain service orchestration and state management with immutability.
detailed_instructions: Fields: round_number, attacker, defender (after round), attacker_damage, defender_damage, combat_ended, winner
Check if defender.is_alive after attacker's strike
If defender dead: return RoundResult with defender_damage=0, combat_ended=True, winner=attacker
Check if attacker alive after counter, set combat_ended and winner accordingly
Test: both survive, attacker kills defender, defender kills attacker in counter

wow_moment.demonstration: Show combat where attacker kills defender in first strike - no counter-attack occurs
wow_moment.audience_value: Business rule enforcement in domain layer, no conditional logic leakage to presentation
